newsitem.title: UK: UK's Labour increases lead over Conservatives - poll.
newsitem.headline: UK's Labour increases lead over Conservatives - poll.

text.p: Britain's opposition Labour Party has increased its opinion poll lead over the ruling Conservatives and is now 27 points ahead, the Daily Telegraph said on Friday.

The poll, ahead of A general election which must be held by next May, said Labour had 55 percent support, a gain of three points in the past month, to 28 percent for the Conservatives and 11 percent for the centrist Liberal Democrats.
The Daily Telegraph findings were in sharp contrast to a poll in the Guardian newspaper on Thursday which said Labour's lead had been sharply reduced.
The ICM poll put Labour on 47 percent, down five points from a poll by the same company last month, with the Conservatives up three at 34 percent and the Liberal Democrats down one at 15 percent.
